lines.cap: Stop copying your MetaTrader trades into a spreadsheet.
This is Traders Journal, and it now connects to MT5 in one click.
No Expert Advisor, no WebRequest, no cloud account.
Just open MetaTrader and log in.
In Traders Journal, open Connections and press Auto-Connect All MT5 Accounts.
It scans your PC and finds every MT5 account.
Want to choose? Hit Scan and Choose, tick your accounts, and Save and Sync.
Your trades land in seconds, with balance, equity and open positions.
Switch on Live Auto-Sync, and new trades arrive every three seconds.
Win rate, profit factor, calendar, all live.
Everything stays on your PC. Read-only. Nothing uploaded.
Traders Journal. Created by Chethiya Rathnasekara.
